messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV3 Billing meter anomalies detected for customer-acct 'acme-corp' — token-count delta > 12% over last 15m. Link: https://rwd/ops/incident/3600008888 :rotating_light:
oncall-max: Taking this — oncall max. Quick summary of impact?
metering-bot: Ingest lag in eu1-kafka-1, consumer lag ~120k, snapshot delay ~5–10m. Timestamp jitter seen, possible replay/duplicate acks.
billing-eli: Overflagging observed for acme-corp and widgetify. Reconciler delta shows ~11k tokens excess in last hour vs ledger.
sre-jen: Need to determine duplication vs delayed emit. Dup = customers may be charged now; delayed = late spikes on next invoice.
oncall-max: Quick query: `SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM emitter WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'` -> +0.9% vs ledger. attaching excerpt.
carla: I restarted emitter-3 (eu1) which had restart_count spike ~03:12. Restart triggered replay of buffered events. logs: `emitter-3: replayed 17 batches`
billing-eli: Reconciler dedupe path expects event_id; we have a regression where event_id is NULL for older buffered messages -> those bypass dedupe and double-count.
oncall-max: Can we toggle replay or pause emitter replays while we patch?
sre-jen: Pushed hotfix to reconciler: `if event_id IS NULL -> compute strong_hash(payload)` then dedupe by hash. Rolling canary in eu1 (2 nodes).
incident-bot: Deploy started: eu1-reconciler v1.2.3-canary -> 2 nodes. Monitoring stream: https://rwd/ops/deploys/3600008888 :rocket:
metering-bot: Canary metrics: duplicate ratio in eu1 down from 0.7% -> 0.02% within 12m. Consumer lag decreasing. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
customer-ops-lina: Sent proactive note to acme-corp support contact and offered temporary credit while we confirm impact. DM me exact affected accounts to include.
billing-eli: Affected list compiled: acme-corp (acct 8321), widgetify (acct 9912), beta-inc (acct 3453). Placing hold on invoice generation for these accounts for 24h. Created ticket BILL-412.
oncall-max: Triage summary: mitigated -> monitoring. We'll watch for 1h and then clear holds if dup ratio <0.1% and ledger reconciles. If stable, revert emitter restart behavior. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Channel archived at 3600009025
